page_title: PAR 0-3 TOU | Paris FC v Toulouse 13/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Neat passing move from Toulouse in order to create new attacking opportunities.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Otavio (Paris FC) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
89' Paris FC seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
88' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastien Dechepy had an easy-decision to make.
87' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Paris FC comes to nothing.
84' Carles Martinez has decided to make a change. Julian Vignolo (Toulouse) replaces Yann Gboho.
84' It's time for a substitution. Noah Edjouma (Toulouse) comes on in place of Djibril Sidibe.
83' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:4.
81' A quickly taken corner by Paris FC.
77' Stephane Gilli prepares a substitution. Moses Simon is replaced by Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC).
77' Stephane Gilli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Thibault De Smet (Paris FC) replacing Tuomas Ollila.
77' The substitution is prepared. Julien Lopez (Paris FC) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jonathan Ikone.
75' The Paris FC players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
73' Adama Camara (Paris FC) has tested the patience of referee Bastien Dechepy and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
71' The Paris FC players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
70' Stephane Gilli has decided to substitute Vincent Marchetti and he is replaced by Willem Geubbels (Paris FC).
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Rafik Messali (Toulouse) comes onto the pitch so that Emersonn can be given a rest.
69' 0 - 3 Goal! Djibril Sidibe produces a great pass that finds Yann Gboho (Toulouse) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a low shot into the back of the net. 0:3.
68' 2:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
66' Tuomas Ollila (Paris FC) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Bastien Dechepy has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
63' Here is a change. Dayann Methalie is going off and Carles Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse).
63' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Santiago Hidalgo as he is replaced by Frank Magri (Toulouse).
63' Moses Simon (Paris FC) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
59' Paris FC enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
59' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
57' Mamadou Mbow (Paris FC) receives a lofted pass from out wide and shoots from close range, but the ball flies way over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
56' Paris FC are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
55' Total attempts – 8:5.
53' Adama Camara (Paris FC) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
52' Stephane Gilli is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Hamari Traore suffers an injury and Nhoa Sangui (Paris FC) comes on.
52' Hamari Traore (Paris FC) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
48' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Paris FC, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+1' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Paris FC, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Bastien Dechepy shows a yellow card to Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) for his blatant foul.
44' Paris FC failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
42' Toulouse can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

41' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Jonathan Ikone (Paris FC) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Guillaume Restes easily catches the ball.
39' Paris FC take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
37' 0 - 2 Goal! Emersonn produces a great pass that finds Yann Gboho (Toulouse) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the right side of the goal. 0:2.
36' 61:39 – the ratio of ball possession.
34' Toulouse are seeing far more of the ball now.
31' Paris FC are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
29' 0 - 1 Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home low into the middle of the net. The goalkeeper was helpless.
26' Paris FC work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
26' Moses Simon (Paris FC) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Paris FC.
24' Emersonn (Toulouse) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
21' Paris FC control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
19' The resulting set piece from Toulouse is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

19' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom left corner. Kevin Trapp anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort. Corner kick. Toulouse will have an opportunity.
19' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
18' Hamari Traore (Paris FC) handles the ball inside the penalty area. The referee blows his whistle and awards Toulouse a penalty after chaos inside the box.
18' Toulouse will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.

14' Emersonn (Toulouse) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Paris FC will have a goal kick.
14' Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.

13' Close! Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Paris FC.
11' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
11' The corner is swung in but Toulouse can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
9' Moses Simon (Paris FC) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
7' Toulouse have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
5' Great teamplay by Toulouse as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Paris FC.

1' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) strikes the ball towards the top left corner of the goal and raises his hands to celebrate, but the goalkeeper somehow manages to deny his attempt. The ball goes out of play. Paris FC are awarded a corner kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Toulouse will take the kick-off.
